title: Demo no-network CI lint is porous: delegation to real api modules and any fetch in demo_api.gleam both pass it
evidence:
VIOLATIONS=$(grep -rn "rsvp\|api_helpers" client/src/demo/ --include="*.gleam" || true)
          # The one permitted network touch is the pre-baked static PDF fetch
          # in demo_api.download (gleam/fetch on /static/demo/*.pdf) — every
          # OTHER demo module must stay import-free of the network layer.
          FETCH_VIOLATIONS=$(grep -rln "gleam/fetch" client/src/demo/ --include="*.gleam" | grep -v "demo_api.gleam" || true)
detail: Two holes in the P0 pin: (1) a demo module adding `import api/vacancy_api` and delegating contains neither the string `rsvp` nor `api_helpers` (those live inside the api modules themselves), so the grep passes while real network calls fire; (2) the fetch whitelist excludes the whole demo_api.gleam file, so a real-endpoint fetch added beside `download` passes too. Current demo/ code verified clean (only gleam/fetch in demo_api.download, hitting /static/demo/*.pdf), so the pin holds today but not against the realistic regression.
recommended_fix: Extend the lint: also grep for `import api/` in client/src/demo/ (allowlist api/api_error + api/auth_api type imports) and scope the fetch exemption to the download function rather than the whole file.

title: Demo navigation-level branches untested: is_demo_route deep-link boot heuristic and BrowserChangedUrl demo enter/exit arms
detail: New 5-pattern prefix heuristic plus the update_inner BrowserChangedUrl demo arms (routes.Demo -> enter_demo; public route -> clear demo state) have no test — demo_flow_test constructs the demo model directly and never routes a BrowserChangedUrl through demo mode. Failure mode is graceful (normal boot / login redirect), hence note.
recommended_fix: Add a flow test driving msg.BrowserChangedUrl with a /demo URI and a v- deep link through client.update, asserting demo_mode flips on entry and clears on exit to a public route.

title: No E2E (bug-hunt) scenario for /demo despite the flow test deferring effect execution to it
detail: The cited bug-hunt E2E does not exist for the demo: grep of .pi/skills/bug-hunt/scenarios/ finds no demo scenario (matches are unrelated seed workflows). Effect execution, refresh-wipe in a real browser, and the static-PDF download path are covered only by the PR's manual browser pass — a level-mix gap on a new public route.
recommended_fix: Add a bug-hunt scenario for /demo (ungated, so no auth setup needed): entry, dashboard render, one detail navigation, reset, and a refresh-wipe assertion; or correct the test comment.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: P0 100%: (1) no-network pinned by CI lint (verified non-vacuous against current code — demo/ imports show no rsvp/api_helpers; sole fetch is the static /static/demo/*.pdf GET in demo_api.download) though porous to future delegation (warning filed); (2) reset-wipe tested (demo_reset_wipes_state_test) and refresh-wipe proven by construction (no storage imports in demo/, pure MVU state); (3) fixture drift guard FULL (fixtures_conformance_test decodes all fixtures through production shared/ decoders plus encode→decode round-trip); (4) seam interception tested (demo_requests_are_intercepted_test) and live path guarded by the pre-existing 595 client tests with api modules untouched by the diff. P1 ~90% (entry/exit/reset/dashboard/detail/leaderboard/comparison/archived/notifications/scoring covered; download-dispatch, refcheck/bulk-invite/reminder dispatch arms, and analytics consent gating covered only by code inspection). Overall ~85%.
recommended_fix: To strengthen: close the lint holes (warning above), add BrowserChangedUrl demo-navigation tests, and one bug-hunt E2E scenario for /demo.
